```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(piptb)
dt <- pipload::pip_load_cache("PRY", 2019, tool = "TB")
```

```{r basic}

# Basic use. mean default
tb(dt,
   vars = "welfare_ppp", 
   weight = "weight")[]

# Basic use. by area and gender
tb(dt,
   vars = "welfare_ppp", 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender")[]


# Poverty status
tb(dt,
   vars = "pov_status", 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender")[]


# Poverty status and welfare
tb(dt,
   vars = c("pov_status", "welfare_ppp", "welfare_lcu"), 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender")[]




# Poverty status and welfare, mean, sum,and max
# sum for poor is the number of people
tb(dt,
   vars = c("pov_status", "welfare_ppp"), 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender", 
   stats = c("mean", "sum", "max"))[]


# Add more poverty lines
tb(dt,
   vars = c("pov_status", "welfare_ppp"), 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender", 
   stats = c("mean", "sum"), 
   povline = c(1.9, 3.2, 5.5))[]



# add super column
tb(dt,
   vars = c("welfare_ppp"), 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender", 
   scol  = "educat4")[]

# add super row
tb(dt,
   vars = c("welfare_ppp"), 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender", 
   scol  = "educat4",
   srow  = "literacy")[]


```
